title: Dodging Bullets: Fear-Setting and Escaping Paralysis
coreMove: Fear-setting makes risk legible: name the worst case, reduce its odds, map repair, and compare it with the cost of inaction.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A stable job feels safe while the cost of another year keeps rising.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use worst case, prevention, repair, and cost of inaction before deciding.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A failed launch sounds permanent until repair steps are named.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show repair steps testing whether the feared outcome is recoverable.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Doing nothing preserves today while draining the next year.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make the cost of inaction visible across months and years.

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders afraid to name a downside
exampleSpecs.stakes: A missed target can be planned for or hidden until it spreads.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Seneca-style negative visualization to create steadier action.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A feared loan can be made less dangerous before the application is filed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show prevention lowering probability rather than merely describing danger.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A life change stalls when bravery is treated as a mood requirement.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show action following analysis rather than a fearless mood.
